title: Adopt the workforce control-plane specification #259-#267
problem: Issues #259-#267 specify one Manager system plus ten worker slots but were planning-only; #268 is the Manager authorization record.

options.summary: Implement #259-#267 in full, including #267 cross-program concurrency, as tools/workforce + docs/engineering-operations/workforce

rationale: #268 authorizes implementation of the full #259-#267 scope. It does not authorize unrelated features, worker self-governance or security bypass; those remain out of scope.
